info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pyrite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their inventory of Pyrite Battery details. Through this API, users can create new entries for battery specifications, enhancing their product catalogs with precise technical data. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product developers who require up-to-date information to inform customers and improve offerings. It streamlines the process of cataloging vital product information, ensuring easy access and management for ongoing business operations.

post.summary: Submit details for the Pyrite Battery.
post.description: This endpoint accepts and processes details related to the Pyrite Battery, enabling users to provide necessary information for further actions or analyses.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary data to create or update details about a pyrite battery. The provided information will be processed to handle the battery's specifications, operational parameters, and any specific configurations. Ensure that the schema fields are adhered to for a successful operation.

200.description: The request has been processed successfully and the details are returned.
